title: Little Office Against Evil Spirits
translationNotice: English translation prepared for Sacrum Florilegium; not supplied in the source PDF.

blocks.english: ℣. O God, come to my assistance.

blocks.source: ℟. Domine ad adjuvandum me festina. Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto. Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper, et in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
blocks.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

blocks.source: Ecce signum crucis Domini nostri Jesu Christi, fugite partes adversae: vicit leo de tribu Juda, radix David. Hoc signum crucis erit in coelo, dum Dominus ad judicandum venerit. Per signum sanctae crucis, Jesus per medium eorum ibat, et confundebat inimicos suos. Per signum sanctae crucis obscurentur oculi eorum, ne videant, et dorsum eorum semper incurva. Per signum sanctae crucis de inimicis nostris libera nos Deus noster. Ostende mihi Domine sanctam crucem tuam, et in nomine suo salvum me fac, et in virtute sua libera me. Domine in virtute sanctae crucis vade inter super inimicos meos formido et pavor. In conspectu sanctae crucis stant immobiles quasi lapides, donec pertranseat populus tuus, quem possedisti. Salvator meus per crucem tuam salvum me fac, qui per sanguinem et crucem tuam salvasti mundum. Crux Christi semper pretiosa salva nos omnibus diebus vitae nostrae. Crux Christi, Jesu sanguine rubricata, defende nos a furore inimicorum tuorum. O bona crux Christi! illumina oculos meos, ne unquam obdormiam in morte, ne quando dicat inimicus meus: praevalui adversus eum.
blocks.english:
Behold the sign of the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ; flee, ye adversaries: the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath conquered.
This sign of the Cross shall be in heaven when the Lord shall come to judge.
Through the sign of the holy Cross, Jesus passed through their midst and confounded His enemies.
Through the sign of the holy Cross, let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back always.
Through the sign of the holy Cross, deliver us from our enemies, O our God.
Show me, O Lord, Thy holy Cross, and in its name save me, and by its power deliver me.
O Lord, by the power of the holy Cross, may dread and fear come upon my enemies.
In the presence of the holy Cross they stand motionless as stones, until Thy people, whom Thou hast possessed, pass over.
My Saviour, save me through Thy Cross, Who through Thy Blood and Cross hast saved the world.
Ever-precious Cross of Christ, save us all the days of our life.
Cross of Christ, reddened with the Blood of Jesus, defend us from the fury of thine enemies.
O good Cross of Christ! Enlighten mine eyes, lest ever I sleep in death, lest mine enemy say: I have prevailed against him.

blocks.source: In conspectu tuo, o crux Christi, locutus sum in lingua mea. Notum fac mihi finem meum, et numerum dierum meorum, ut sciam quid desit mihi. Domine, crux sancta tua fac mecum signum in bonum, ut videant, qui oderunt me, et confundantur, quoniam tu Domine adjuvisti me et consolatus es me. Dirupisti Domine per crucem tuam vincula mea: tibi sacrificabo hostiam laudis, et nomen crucis tuae invocabo. Per sanctam crucem tuam Domine pertraxi fugam a me, et non est, qui requirat animam meam. Clamavi ad te crux benedicta, dixi: Tu es spes mea et portio mea in terra viventium. Adoro te, o crux gloriosa, et in brachia tua commendo spiritum meum: redemisti me crux magistra veritatis. Confiteantur tibi o crux admirabilis omnia opera Dei, et sancti ejus semper benedicant tibi. Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto. Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper, et in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
blocks.english:
In thy presence, O Cross of Christ, I have spoken with my tongue.
Make known unto me mine end and the number of my days, that I may know what is wanting unto me.
O Lord, through Thy holy Cross work a sign for good in my behalf, that they who hate me may see and be confounded, for Thou, O Lord, hast helped and comforted me.
Through Thy Cross, O Lord, Thou hast broken my bonds: unto Thee will I sacrifice an offering of praise, and I will call upon the name of Thy Cross.
Through Thy holy Cross, O Lord, I have drawn flight away from me, and there is none who seeketh my soul.
I cried unto thee, blessed Cross; I said: Thou art my hope and my portion in the land of the living.
I adore thee, O glorious Cross, and into thine arms I commend my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Cross, teacher of truth.
Let all the works of God give praise unto thee, O wondrous Cross, and let His Saints ever bless thee.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

blocks.source: Crux Christi, crux sancta, crux venerabilis et benedicta, crux Christi via, veritas, et vita; crux dulcis et amabilis, crux decora et appreciabilis, semper sis mihi contra inimicos meos virtus, et victoria inexpugnabilis.
blocks.english: Cross of Christ, holy Cross, venerable and blessed Cross, Cross of Christ, way, truth, and life; sweet and lovable Cross, fair and precious Cross, be ever unto me strength and unconquerable victory against mine enemies.

blocks.source: ℣. Dignare me laudare te, o crux sancta.
blocks.english: ℣. Vouchsafe that I may praise thee, O holy Cross.

blocks.source: ℟. Da mihi virtutem contra hostes tuos.
blocks.english: ℟. Give me strength against thine enemies.

blocks.source: Deus propitius esto mihi peccatori, et per sanctam crucem tuam esto custos mei omnibus diebus vitae meae. Deus Abraham, Deus Isaac, Deus Jacob, miserere mei, et mitte in adjutorium meum sanctum archangelum tuum Michaelem, qui me custodiat, protegat, soletur, visitet, atque defendat ab inimicis meis visibilibus et invisibilibus, ac ab ejus superna virtute omnes perterriti fugiant et pereant. Per crucem et passionem Domini nostri Jesu Christi. Qui tecum vivit et regnat in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
blocks.english: O God, be merciful to me a sinner, and through Thy holy Cross be my guardian all the days of my life. God of Abraham, God of Isaac, God of Jacob, have mercy upon me, and send to my assistance Thy holy Archangel Michael, that he may guard, protect, comfort, visit, and defend me from my enemies, visible and invisible; and may they all, terrified by his heavenly power, flee and perish. Through the Cross and Passion of our Lord Jesus Christ. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee for ever and ever. Amen.

editorialNotes.text: The source prints the grammatically irregular “vade inter super inimicos meos formido et pavor,” rendered provisionally “may dread and fear come upon my enemies.” The phrase “pertraxi fugam a me” is translated literally as “I have drawn flight away from me”; its intended sense remains uncertain. The source wording is retained in both cases.
